fields.options:
WhatsApp
Messenger
Instagram
Telegram
Slack
Email
Google Chat
Microsoft Teams

fields.description: Existing integration that owns this channel's credentials. VK and WeCom gateways require it; use its Password credential rows for the adapter's documented keys.
fields.label: Connected integration

fields.description: Derived from the connected integration's phone_number_id credential. At most one enabled WhatsApp gateway may use a given phone number ID.
fields.label: Phone number ID

fields.description: Optional. A frappe_whatsapp WhatsApp Account whose phone ID must equal this gateway's phone number ID. When set and frappe_whatsapp is installed, replies are sent through it; otherwise Huf calls the Meta Cloud API directly with the connected integration's credentials.
fields.label: WhatsApp Account

fields.description: Lets this gateway's agents send free-form messages to numbers with no open 24-hour window. Off by default.
fields.label: Agent may send outside the 24-hour window

fields.description: Lets this gateway's agents save template drafts for human approval. Off by default.
fields.label: Agent may draft templates

fields.description: Agent-created templates are submitted to Meta without human approval. Off by default.
fields.label: Agent templates skip approval

fields.description: Who this gateway's agents may message. Current contact: only the person in the conversation (default, safest). Allow-list: also the numbers below. Approved contacts: also any Approved sender in this gateway's access list. Any number: no recipient limit (use only for trusted agents).
fields.label: Agent recipient scope
fields.options:
Current contact
Allow-list
Approved contacts
Any number

fields.description: Phone numbers agents may message besides the current contact, one per line or comma separated.
fields.label: Allowed recipient numbers

fields.description: Most messages one agent run may send. 0 means no limit.
fields.label: Agent sends per run

fields.description: Most messages this gateway's agents may send in any rolling 24 hours. 0 means no limit.
fields.label: Agent sends per day

fields.description: Optional. Name of an approved WhatsApp template (no variables) sent when a reply is due but the 24-hour customer-service window is closed. If empty, such replies fail with a clear error.
fields.label: Fallback template

fields.description: Language code of the fallback template (for example en_US). In connector mode the language of the matching WhatsApp Templates row is used when found.
fields.label: Fallback template language

fields.description: Optional JSON list (or {name: value} map for named variables) of values for the fallback template's body variables, for example ["{{contact_name}}", "Acme"]. {{contact_name}} becomes the contact's WhatsApp profile name (or "there"). Empty fills every variable with the contact name.
fields.label: Fallback template params

fields.description: Link previews in text replies. Default sends no preview. Applies identically with and without frappe_whatsapp.
fields.label: Link previews

fields.description: When the customer sends a voice note, answer with a voice note (the agent's text-to-speech model; needs ffmpeg on the server). Replies longer than 1500 characters, or any failure, are sent as text instead.
fields.label: Voice note replies
fields.options:
Off
Voice only
Text and voice

fields.description: Mark the customer's message as read and show the typing indicator while the agent works (best effort).
fields.label: Typing indicator

fields.description: Optional plain text sent to the customer when the agent run fails (at most once per sender per 10 minutes). Empty means send nothing. Takes precedence over the fallback_reply_text credential row.
fields.label: Error reply text

fields.description: Maximum send attempts for a reply that hits a temporary WhatsApp error (rate limit, 5xx, timeout). The agent is never rerun.
fields.label: Reply send attempts

fields.description: The least-privileged Huf user used when this gateway starts an Agent or Flow. Never use Administrator.
fields.label: Run as user

fields.description: Experimental. Answer inbound WhatsApp calls from approved callers with a pre-recorded greeting, then hang up. Calls are never recorded. Off by default.
fields.label: Calling (experimental)

fields.description: Unknown callers are always rejected. Only approved senders are answered.
fields.label: Answer calls with a greeting

fields.description: Opus/ogg, under 60 seconds. This audio starts with an announcement that the caller is speaking to an automated assistant.
fields.label: Greeting audio

fields.description: Direct messages are denied unless an approved Gateway Access Entry matches. Pairing creates a pending request but never executes the triggering message.
fields.label: Direct-message policy

fields.description: Rooms/channels are denied unless an approved room access entry matches.
fields.label: Room policy

fields.description: Applies after room admission. Direct-message pairing never grants room access.
fields.label: Room sender policy

fields.description: Reply to unknown senders with their pairing code. Off by default: on a public number every stranger would otherwise trigger an outbound message -- the pending Gateway Access Entry is still created either way.
fields.label: Send pairing code reply

fields.description: Maximum Pending pairing requests per gateway. New strangers are ignored while the queue is full. 0 turns the cap off.
fields.label: Max pending pairing requests

fields.description: Maximum pairing code replies sent per day. The pending entry is still created when the cap is reached. 0 means no replies.
fields.label: Max pairing replies per day

fields.description: Messages accepted per sender per 10 minutes. Extra messages are rejected (sender_rate_limited). 0 turns the limit off.
fields.label: Inbound messages per sender (per 10 min)

fields.description: One keyword per line. A message that is exactly one of these (ignoring case and punctuation) opts the sender out.
fields.label: Opt-out keywords

fields.description: One keyword per line. Restores a sender who opted out.
fields.label: Opt-in keywords

fields.default: You have been unsubscribed and will not receive further messages. Reply START to resubscribe.
fields.description: Sent once when a sender opts out.
fields.label: Opt-out confirmation text
When no route matches, send to

fields.description: WhatsApp Business Account id. Used when no WhatsApp Account is linked (direct mode) so Meta account_update events can set the connection state. A linked account's business_id takes precedence.
fields.label: WhatsApp Business Account ID
